g.text: Tides can keep contributing through a wind lull
Selected worst 168-hour wind window of 2023 in the supplied northern Scotland profiles.
Calculated from supplied modeled profiles, not measured turbine output. The lower panel shows regular tidal gaps.
This selected week illustrates complementarity; it does not establish year-round reliability or a universal pattern.
